Our Parks

Our Parkswebmaster2026-04-19T17:24:22+03:00

Kenya is home to some of the world’s most extraordinary wildlife landscapes, and Kenya Wildlife Service (KWS) is proud to manage and protect them. From the snow-capped peaks of Mt. Kenya to the vast red plains of Tsavo, the flamingo-fringed shores of Lake Nakuru to the coral reefs of the Kenyan coast; explore our parks and find the adventure that calls to you.
